verdict.rationale: Paddle offers overlay/inline checkout via Paddle.js with minimal frontend coding, plus API/dashboard transaction creation, sandbox testing, and a merchant-of-record model requiring no additional tax/compliance setup — all pointing to a fast, self-serve path from signup to accepting a real card payment. Signup speed itself isn't directly evidenced (e.g. no explicit 'go live in a day' timeline), so missing for 10: explicit onboarding/approval-time documentation, independent founder testimonial confirming same-day live acceptance.
